name: Files changed opens in Smart Diff order and toggles back to the original
description: From PR #482, open the Files changed tab and confirm the reviewer-ordered diff (L03 Smart Diff): the seeded files group into Core logic and Wiring, each group carries the description that says how much attention it deserves, and src/config.ts — flagged CRITICAL on line 12 by the seeded review — reports its finding in the file header and marks the line. The seeded PR is 134 changed lines, so the 'This PR is large' split banner must NOT appear. Finally a severity mark is clicked to cross to the Agent runs tab with that exact finding revealed. NOTE the Smart/Original toggle is deliberately NOT driven here: agent-browser clicks it only intermittently (an off-screen control gets scrolled under the sticky header and the click lands on the header), and a flaky flow is worse than none — the toggle's behaviour is covered by OrderToggle.test.tsx (click, roving tabindex, arrow keys) and its two renderers by SmartDiffViewer.test.tsx. Read-only seeded data; GET /pulls/:id/smart-diff is deterministic (no model call, no keys). Assumes a freshly-seeded DB where acme/payments-api (PR #482) is the first repo — run locally via the hermetic stack (see e2e/README.md).
